description: Computes the required minimum distribution for 2026 or 2027 from the prior year-end balance and the age or birth year, on the IRS Uniform Lifetime Table, or the Joint and Last Survivor Table when the spouse is the sole beneficiary and more than 10 years younger; returns the divisor, the deadline, the SECURE 2.0 start age (73, or 75 for those born 1960 or later), the first-year April 1 option and the two RMDs it stacks into one year, and a multi-year projection with growth. With filing_status and the year's other income (Social Security, pension, other IRA money) it adds the 2026 federal and state tax the RMD adds, the Social Security it makes taxable, the IRMAA effect, and what a QCD would take off: those tax figures come from QuantCalc's federal and state tax APIs and need a connected QuantCalc PRO licence or Tax Season Pass (the RMD itself does not). The same figures as the website's RMD calculator.

age.description: The age the owner reaches by December 31 of the distribution year. Give this or birth_year.

balance_prior_year_end.description: The traditional IRA (or plan) balance on December 31 of the year before the distribution year.

birth_year.description: The owner's birth year; used instead of age when given.

filing_status.description: 2026 filing status (single, mfj, mfs, hoh). With it, and for 2026 only, the result adds the federal and state tax the RMD adds (licence needed).

growth_rate_percent.description: Annual growth of the balance for the projection and the delayed-first-RMD figure, in percent (5 = 5%). Default 0.

other_ira_distributions.description: Other 2026 IRA withdrawals or Roth conversions beyond this RMD, for the tax. Default 0.

pension.description: Taxable 2026 pension and annuity income, for the tax. Default 0.

qcd.description: The part of the RMD sent straight to charity as a qualified charitable distribution (capped at the $111,000 2026 limit and the balance). Default 0.

social_security.description: Gross 2026 Social Security benefits of the household, for the tax. Default 0.

spouse_age.description: The spouse's age reached in the distribution year: for the Joint and Last Survivor Table, and on a joint return for the tax. On a joint return default the owner's age, stated.

spouse_sole_beneficiary.description: The spouse is the sole beneficiary all year: when the spouse is more than 10 years younger the Joint and Last Survivor Table applies. Needs spouse_age. Default false.

spouse_split.description: Joint return only: whose the other IRA withdrawals and pension are on the state return (even, filer or spouse); the RMD is the owner's. Default even, stated.

state.description: Optional: two-letter code of the state (or DC) for the state tax line. Absent: federal only.

year.description: The distribution year: 2026 or 2027 (the same Uniform Lifetime Table). Default 2026.

name: calculate_rmd
title: Required minimum distribution (RMD) for 2026 or 2027
